description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM part attaches to the Inside door window frame and keeps glass tight inside the window frame.
Glass Channel Run Has Contour Cuts Pre-Made Into the Rubber for Easy Installation
All Parts Have Felt Covered Surface So The Glass Glides Easily Though the Channel
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Glass Run – LH & RH
Qty 2 – Inner Glass Door Scrapes – LH & RH
Qty 2 – Outer Glass Door Scrapes – LH & RH
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Model
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Model
